  ◉ lume  /  a quiet place for curious minds                                                                                   ● LOCAL LIBRARY  
 [− Library]        [+ Articles]       [− Reader]         [− Annotations]                                                                       
╭ 01  Library ──────────────╭─ Lume · field guide · / search · j/k scroll · Esc close ─────────────────────────────╮────────────────────[≡]─[−]╮
│                           │/ resize                                                                              │                           │
│  LIBRARY                  │1/5 matches · n/N next/previous · Esc clear                                           │                           │
│▎ Inbox                    │  Ctrl-w +/-      Resize by two columns; custom splits use two percentage points      │                           │
│  All articles             │                  Also >/<. Collapsed siblings never absorb the resize.               │                           │
│  Read next                │                  Nested minimum sizes keep Articles visible when space permits.      │                           │
│  Favorites                │  Ctrl-w c / a    Collapse focused panel / expand article notes                       │                           │
│  Read                     │  :panel NAME     Toggle library, articles, reader or annotations                     │                           │
│  Notebook                 │  :panel-focus NAME       Expand and focus a panel                                    │                           │
│  Trash                    │  :panel-move left|right  Reorder focused panel                                       │                           │
│  Continue reading         │  :panel-resize +4        Columns in classic layouts; percentage points in splits     │                           │
│  Since last visit         │  :panel-close    Collapse focused panel, including Reader and notes                  │                           │
│  Grouped articles         │  Every panel has a [−] button. Top [+] buttons reopen hidden panels.                 │                           │
│  For you                  │  All panels may be collapsed. Tab then restores the reader.                          │                           │
│                           │  Space c / :compact      Switch headline density                                     │                           │
│  FEEDS                    │  Space z / :zen          Center the reading column                                   │                           │
│  Systems Journal          │  Z / F11 / :fullscreen   Expand article to the whole terminal                        │                           │
│                           │  Esc             Leave fullscreen or cancel visual selection                         │                           │
│                           │  :width 82       Prose width, 40–140 columns                                         │                           │
│                           │  :fullscreen-width 80    Centered fullscreen text, 40–140 columns                    │───────────────────────────╯
│                           │  :justify on|off  Visually justify prose; copied text stays unchanged                │────────────────────[≡]─[−]╮
│                           │                  Code, tables, headings and final paragraph rows stay aligned        │                           │
│                           │  :save-status    Inspect session write failures; :w retries outstanding saves        │                           │
│                           │  :sidebar-width 23       Library width, 16–48 columns                                │                           │
│                           │  :articles-width 36      Headlines width, 24–80 columns                              │                           │
│                           │  Small terminals show the focused panel. Tab reveals another panel.                  │                           │
│                           │  Layout changes persist. Fullscreen keeps your chosen panel widths.                  │                           │
│                           │                                                                                      │                           │
│                           │  ── MOUSE AND PANEL GESTURES ────────────────────────────────────────                │                           │
│                           │  :mouse on|off|status     Capture preference / observed terminal events              │                           │
│                           │  Click           Focus a panel, open an article or jump to a note                    │                           │
│                           │  Click image     Open enlarged image; +/- zoom, 0 fit, Esc return                    │                           │
│                           │  Enter on link   Read HTTP(S) links inside Lume; local anchors                       │                           │
│                           │                  jump to a section. Ctrl-o goes back; Ctrl-i goes forward.           │                           │
│                           │                  Place the reader cursor with a click or Vim motions first.          │                           │
│                           │                  :edit-note edits a note overlapping a link.                         │                           │
│                           │  Hover ● / text  Preview a passage note; click its marker or popup to edit           │                           │
│                           │                  Mouse motion reporting is required for hover previews.              │                           │
│                           │                  Enter / :edit-note works from the keyboard.                         │                           │
